condition: An HTTP MCP caller without a client API key must not invoke NetLicensing operations using NETLICENSING_API_KEY from the operator environment
prerequisites: HTTP transport with NETLICENSING_API_KEY configured and an untrusted caller reaching an MCP tool route without a caller key; the health endpoint is excluded.
safe: A nonempty valid caller key set for the request is used by the upstream client and reset after the request; authorized caller-bound credentials are not fallback
review: The client ContextVar defaults from the operator environment and supplies HTTP Basic credentials. Previously the middleware forwarded missing-key requests without overriding that context. The fix rejects missing credentials outside the health endpoint before forwarding while retaining set/reset around caller-authenticated requests.
safe_prerequisites: HTTP MCP route receives a valid caller-owned API key; the request context is set before forwarding and reset afterward; health checks are excluded.
